title: Gaussian Sweep Decomposition for Exact Pathwidth on Sparse Graphs
topic: Path Decompositions of Sparse Graphs via Gaussian Sweeps and Faster Exponential Algorithms
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: We present a compact exponential algorithm for computing the exact pathwidth of undirected sparse graphs. The method enumerates all vertex subsets via a bit-mask dynamic program and applies a Gaussian sweep over the active set of each prefix. We formalise the optimal-substructure invariant that guarantees the recurrence yields the minimal width, and we prove that the algorithm runs in $O(n\,2^{n})$ time and $O(2^{n})$ space, matching the lower bound for exact exponential solutions on sparse instances. The implementation is written in pure Chronos-Interpreter and is fully reproducible; the source code is available at \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/Chronos-Interpreter-advanced-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261105_020111_path_decompositions_of_sparse}. \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/Chronos-Interpreter-advanced-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261105_020111_path_decompositions_of_sparse}
